run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with the mailing group cc'd
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with a custom --cc flag to add extra recipients to the patch upload
review_main_function: review the main function that wraps upload.py and appends the Google Test group to the cc list
refactor_main_function: refactor the main function to support additional cc recipients or different upload scripts
summarize_upload_gtest: summarize the upload_gtest.py script that passes CLI flags to upload.py with an auto-added cc address
